data.title: Service catalog · dependencies
data.text: Storefront depends on checkout. Checkout depends on payments and inventory. Payments depends on ledger. Inventory depends on notifications. Commerce owns checkout and payments; Platform owns inventory and ledger; Experience owns storefront and notifications.

data.title: Checkout synthetic monitor
data.text: Checkout requests return HTTP 500 after payments v2.4.

data.title: Payments v2.4 release record
data.text: Payments v2.4 enabled strict_currency_validation. Checkout still sends legacy currency strings. The previous v2.3 release predates ledger schema 2. Both rollback and a runtime flag change require the current compatibility advisory.

data.title: INC-1988 · historical recovery
data.text: Last month payments validation errors were resolved by rolling back to v2.3. That incident used ledger schema 1. This is historical evidence, not proof of current compatibility. Verify the ledger schema before rollback.

data.title: Payments runtime configuration
data.text: strict_currency_validation=true. Toggle is scoped to payments. Disabling it restores acceptance of legacy currency strings, but requires a current safety advisory. Verify downstream checkout and storefront probes after any change.

data.title: Last received ledger compatibility advisory
data.text: The last received signed advisory reports ledger schema 1 as of 08:00 UTC. It permits rollback to payments v2.3. A flag-only mitigation has not been approved in this advisory. A later schema migration may supersede this record; runtime preconditions are checked again before any action executes.

policies.reason: The last received schema 1 advisory permits payments v2.3 rollback.
